// install: Frozen lockfile so a Vercel cache miss can't silently install a different dep version than CI did. If you ever see a 'lockfile out of date' error, run `pnpm install` locally and commit the lockfile.
// build: Turbo's filter syntax: build @vivasvana/web AND all its upstream dependencies (config, db). Gets us turbo's remote cache for the @vivasvana/db generate step.
// ignoreCommand: Skip rebuild if neither apps/web nor packages/* changed. Slashes the deploy queue when you push API-only changes. Exit 0 = skip, Exit 1 = build.
ignoreCommand: git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- apps/web packages || exit 1
